About the Team
Our US Marketplace Strategy & Operations team is responsible for building, scaling and improving the way in which we provide Restaurant delivery. We build our restaurant selection, test 0 → 1 products to give merchants more opportunity to delight their consumers, and optimize ways to improve our marketplace to increase the return on investment our partners gain from partnering with DoorDash. This team focuses on all things Restaurants ranging from selection, to merchandising, to consumer strategy, to leveraging our logistics network in new ways, to so much more!

We are seeking an Associate Manager to join our Marketplace Strategy & Operations team, with a focus on Restaurant Growth. This team is dedicated to growing our restaurant marketplace by launching new selection, enhancing in-app merchandising, helping negotiate new merchant partnerships, and commercializing products that help our restaurant partners grow their businesses on DoorDash. In this role, you will define and execute DoorDash’s restaurant strategy, creating sustainable value for restaurants, consumers, and Dashers while unlocking incremental marketplace revenue.

Operate.
You’ll become an expert on running a sustainable marketplace business — creating value for merchants, Dashers, and consumers alike.

You have 4-6+ years of experience
in a problem-solving role (consulting, tech, banking).

and resist “this is how it’s always been done” thinking.
You thrive with a diverse set of responsibilities
and love working across teams and disciplines.
You’re an analytical powerhouse
— you let data win arguments and are comfortable pulling your own data in SQL and modeling in Excel.
You’re a collaborator
with experience managing stakeholders across diverse audiences, from front-line doers to senior executives.

jobs.description: ROLE SUMMARY The Clinician Medical Monitor is accountable for providing medical and scientific expertise and oversight for Clinical Trials and serves as a single point of accountability for design, execution, monitoring, delivery and reporting of one or more clinical studies and to ensure patient safety. jobs.description: Overview Being good neighbors – helping people, investing in our communities, and making the world a better place – is who we are at State Farm. It is at the core of how we operate and the reason for our success. We're moving with urgency to become a Next Gen Good Neighbor, with technology that strengthens human connections and enhances the customer experience. As an employee, you'll spend less time navigating systems and more time applying judgment, empathy, and expertise in the moments that matter most. Location: Bloomington, IL; Dunwoody, GA; Richardson, TX; Tempe, AZ Hybrid Work arrangement: A "Hybrid" position means selected candidates will be assigned to a facility and will spend some time working both in office and from their home. SPONSORSHIP: Applicants for this position are required to be eligible to lawfully work in the U.S. immediately; employer will not sponsor applicants for U.S. work authorization (e.g. H-1B visa) for this opportunity. Grow Your Skills, Grow Your Potential Responsibilities Are you passionate about shaping the future of customer and employee experiences at State Farm? Do you enjoy turning complex and ambiguous opportunities into clear, validated product direction? Are you curious about how emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence and agentic experiences, can improve how people work and interact with State Farm? The Innovation Experience Design team is seeking an Experience Lead to shape new products, services, capabilities, and ways of working across the Innovation lifecycle. In this role, you will lead Experience Design engagements from Intake and Discovery through proof of concept, Pilot, and Transition. Your strongest ownership will occur early in the lifecycle, where you will help teams define the right problem, identify and validate critical assumptions, understand customer and employee needs, and establish a clear experience strategy before significant investment is made. You will partner with Group Product Managers, Product Owners, business partners, Enterprise Research, Technology, and Experience Design practitioners to connect user needs, business outcomes, and technical possibilities. As initiatives move into experimentation and delivery, you will continue to provide strategic and creative direction so the work remains grounded in validated insights, the intended experience, and measurable outcomes. In this role, you will be responsible for: Lead Experience Design across multiple innovation initiatives, providing strategic continuity from Intake and Discovery through proof of concept, Pilot, and Transition Partner with Product, Technology, Enterprise Research, business partners, and Experience Design practitioners to clarify opportunities, define problems, align on intended value, and identify the assumptions and evidence needed to move forward Lead Discovery by combining research, data, facilitation, service design, concept development, and prototyping to evaluate customer desirability, business viability, technical feasibility, and strategic alignment Translate insights into clear experience strategies, priority use cases, hypotheses, success measures, decision ready artifacts, and recommendations for experimentation Provide strategic and creative direction as practitioners move concepts into detailed design, testing, and delivery, ensuring the validated problem, experience intent, and intended outcomes remain connected to execution Evaluate research and experiment results, communicate recommendations to teams and leaders, and help determine whether initiatives should advance, change direction, require further validation, pause, or exit Champion customer centered and evidence based decision making while advancing Experience Design standards, tools, accessibility, design systems, and practitioner development across the Innovation portfolio Qualifications Competitive candidates will have the following skills and experience: Seven or more years of applicable experience in Experience Design, Product Design, UX Strategy, Service Design, Design Research, or a related discipline Demonstrated experience leading ambiguous Discovery efforts and shaping new products, services, or capabilities from problem definition through validated experience strategy Strong knowledge of human centered design, product discovery, service design, research, prototyping, Design Thinking, and iterative experimentation Experience synthesizing research, analytics, business context, and technical information into hypotheses, experience strategies, success measures, and actionable recommendations Strong facilitation, storytelling, and stakeholder leadership skills, with the ability to influence decisions across Product, Technology, Research, Design, business partners, governance groups, and senior leaders Ability to provide strategic and creative direction while enabling practitioners to maintain ownership of detailed design and execution across multiple concurrent initiatives Proficiency in Figma, FigJam, prototyping, and presentation tools, with working knowledge of accessibility, content strategy, interaction design, information architecture, service design, visual design, and established design systems A portfolio demonstrating strategic thinking, problem framing, research synthesis, concept development, stakeholder influence, experimentation, and measurable customer or business outcomes Preferred experience: Experience working in innovation, incubation, emerging technology, new product development, or enterprise experimentation Current or previous Experience Lead experience, or senior Product Experience Designer experience with demonstrated readiness to lead complex engagements Practical experience applying artificial intelligence across product, design, research, or operational workflows to improve quality, efficiency, learning, decision making, or customer and employee experiences Experience designing, building, configuring, or evaluating artificial intelligence agents and agentic workflows, including capabilities, instructions, data requirements, testing, evaluation criteria, and human oversight Familiarity with Visual Studio Code, OpenAI Codex, Claude Code, or comparable development and agentic coding tools, including their use for prototyping, research synthesis, artifact creation, and workflow automation Experience partnering with Product and Technology on artificial intelligence functionality, integrations, responsible use, and both no code and coded proof of concept activities Experience operating within a large and complex enterprise, with State Farm Product Design or Experience Design experience preferred Items of note: This role may support multiple innovation initiatives across different stages of the lifecycle A portfolio review will be required for candidates who advance to the interview phase The portfolio should demonstrate the candidate’s individual contribution, strategic point of view, problem framing, research and synthesis, concept development, facilitation, stakeholder influence, experimentation approach, and connection to measurable customer or business outcomes Our Benefits Because work-life balance is a priority at State Farm, compensation is based on our standard 38:45-hour work week! Potential starting salary range: $135,000 - $155,000 Starting salary will be based on skills, background, and experience. High end of the range limited to applicants with significant relevant experience and living in high cost of labor location like CA/NY/NJ/Etc. Potential yearly incentive pay up to 10% of base salary At State Farm, we offer more than just a paycheck. Check out our suite of benefits designed to give you the flexibility you need to take care of you and your family! Get Paid! On top of our competitive pay, you are eligible for an annual raise and bonus. Stay Well! Focus on you and your family’s health with our robust health and wellbeing programs. State Farm pays most of your healthcare premium, and we offer multiple healthcare plan options, including a high deductible plan. All medical plans provide 100% coverage for in-network preventative care, AND you and your family have access to vision, dental, telemedicine, 24/7 mental health professionals, and much more! Develop and Grow! Take advantage of educational benefits like industry leading training programs, top-notch tuition assistance programs, employee resource groups, and mentoring. Plan Ahead! You can also start a savings account or consider financing through our State Farm Federal Credit Union! Take a Little “You” Time! With the opportunity to initially earn up to 20 days annually plus parental leave, paid holidays, celebration day, life leave (40 hours/year), bereavement leave, and community service/education support days, there will be plenty of time for you! Give Back! We offer several ways to give back through our Matching Gift Program, Good Neighbor Grant Program, and the Employee Assistance Fund. Finish Strong! Plan for retirement using free financial advisors and a 401(k) plan with company contributions of up to 7% of your salary. Visit our State Farm Careers page for more information on our benefits , locations , and the hiring process of joining the State Farm team!
